◆ How to use

Zayne Child Portrait
1. Download UniqueChildren Talk, this mod can provide portraits and conversations for your children!
2. Change the name of the portrait image file to your child's name.
(Ex: Child name is Asa, then change the file name to Asa.png, Asa2.png...and so on, keep the number after the name, so that the child's portrait can match the clothing!)
3. Finish!
Path ▼
Mods\UniqueChildren Talk\assets\Portraits
－－－－－－－
Zayne Child Sprites
1. Download UniqueChildren, this mod can change your children into different clothes!
2.Overwrite my file to the specified path.
3. Finish!
Path ▼
Mods\UniqueChildren\assets\Adopted\Zayne
Mods\UniqueChildren\assets\Natural\Zayne

*Child portrait is in HD, he will need Portraiture or HD Portraits to work.

Portraiture version: 
You only need to place the child's portrait (named) in Portraiture, but Portraiture currently has a bug. It will only display the portrait of the first set of clothing and cannot display other clothing correctly.

HD Portraits version (you need to delete Portraiture to use this):
1. Download the sample package of optional files
2. Change the child name in content.json to your child’s name
3. Place the child's portrait into the corresponding folder in assets. The image file names only need to be named 1, 2, 3, and 4.
4. Put the sample package into Mods
5. Finish!!
－－－－－－－

*孩子肖像是高清的，他會需要Portraiture或HD Portraits才能運作。

Portraiture版：
你只需將孩子的肖像（已命名）放置在Portraiture即可，但Portraiture目前有bug，他只會顯示第一套服裝的肖像，並不能正確顯示其他服裝。

HD Portraits版（使用這個需要刪除Portraiture）：
1.下載可選文件的示例包

3.將孩子肖像置入assets裡的對應文件夾，圖檔名稱只需命名為1、2、 3、 4。
4.將示例包放入Mods
5.完成!
